bibliographic.title: Seven's Deadly
bibliographic.author: EJA
bibliographic.description:
Plagued with dreams of a life unfamiliar to you and parents who could never love you, you ultimately decided to finish it all. Standing atop the tallest building in Vegas you stare down at eminent demise… Only for things to be turned completely on their heads.

Confronted by a woman claiming to be the very devil of pride herself you are to become the contractor. The only being able to contract all seven sins and return the four horsemen to their proper glory.
Chaos is going to occur and you are the bringer of it.
